# Manual approval flow for extreme price changes

Description

Implement a manual approval flow for price changes deemed "extreme" by volatility rules so operators can review before applying.

Acceptance criteria

- Workflow: detection -> draft changes -> operator review -> approve/apply or reject.
- Audit entries recorded with user and timestamp.
- Notifications to operators when approvals are pending.
